custom_logic_notes: The EA uses a custom indicator 'ForexProfitBoost_2nb' with 5+ buffers (at least buffers 2 and 4 are used for signals). Signal logic: Up[1]!=EMPTY_VALUE triggers long entry if Dn[0]!=EMPTY_VALUE (confirming prior bearish state) and closes shorts. Dn[1]!=EMPTY_VALUE triggers short entry if Up[0]!=EMPTY_VALUE (confirming prior bullish state) and closes longs. The UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime are passed to position open functions (likely used as expiration or gating). The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, CIsNewBar, and LoadHistory — all need manual Python reimplementation. LoadHistory pre-loads bar history; CIsNewBar ensures once-per-bar execution. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose are boolean inputs allowing users to disable specific trade directions.
python_conversion_notes: Must reverse-engineer ForexProfitBoost_2nb indicator logic: it combines EMA(7, CLOSE), SMA(21, CLOSE), and BB(15, 1.0 dev, shift 1). Buffer 2 = down signals, Buffer 4 = up signals. EMPTY_VALUE = no signal. The signal confirmation logic requires two consecutive bar checks (SignalBar and SignalBar+1). TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions must be reimplemented: position open/close with SL/TP in points, margin-based lot sizing, new bar detection, and history loading. The SignalBar input (default 1) means signals are read from bar index 1 (previous completed bar), making this suitable for next-bar-open backtesting.
